title: Your Pruney Fingers Are Secretly Rain Tires
caption:
Pruney bath fingers? That's your body's rain-tire mode
A cozy bubble bath turns to shock when he spots his wrinkled fingertips.
Your nervous system shrinks blood vessels to wrinkle fingertips for a tighter wet grip, like built-in rain tires.
Do your hands prune super fast too?
Save this fact and follow @fruit_drama_tv for daily science.
